{
  "labels": [
    {"i": 0, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Hello सुधीर जी आपको water bottle filling machine की requirement है ना?"},
    {"i": 1, "speaker": "bot", "text": "ठीक है मैं Tanya बोल रही हूं IndiaMART से।"},
    {"i": 2, "speaker": "bot", "text": "हमारे पास कई अच्छे sellers available हैं जिनसे मैं आपको connect कराऊंगी।"},
    {"i": 3, "speaker": "bot", "text": "बस कुछ details confirm कर दीजिए।"},
    {"i": 4, "speaker": "bot", "text": "automation grade में आपको क्या चाहिए automatic, semi-automatic या manual?"},
    {"i": 5, "speaker": "caller", "text": "तो देखिए।"},
    {"i": 6, "speaker": "bot", "text": "मेरा नाम Tanya है।"},
    {"i": 7, "speaker": "bot", "text": "मैं IndiaMART से बात कर रही हूं।"},
    {"i": 8, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Automation grade में क्या चाहिए?"},
    {"i": 9, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Automatic, semi-automatic या manual?"},
    {"i": 10, "speaker": "caller", "text": "manual manual."},
    {"i": 11, "speaker": "bot", "text": "ठीक है?"},
    {"i": 12, "speaker": "bot", "text": "manual select कर रही हूं।"},
    {"i": 13, "speaker": "bot", "text": "अब बताइए production capacity में आपको कौन सी चाहिए?"},
    {"i": 14, "speaker": "bot", "text": "40 BPM या 60 BPM?"},
    {"i": 15, "speaker": "caller", "text": "कौन अच्छा होगा?"},
    {"i": 16, "speaker": "bot", "text": "अगर आपको कम production चाहिए तो 40 BPM अच्छा रहेगा।"},
    {"i": 17, "speaker": "bot", "text": "ज्यादा चाहिए तो 60 BPM चुन सकते हैं।"},
    {"i": 18, "speaker": "bot", "text": "आपको कौन सी चाहिए?"},
    {"i": 19, "speaker": "caller", "text": "हम्म।"},
    {"i": 20, "speaker": "caller", "text": "ହଁ ଟିକେ କଥା କହିଦିଅ ଟିକେ।"},
    {"i": 21, "speaker": "bot", "text": "बहुत बढ़िया।"},
    {"i": 22, "speaker": "bot", "text": "60 BPM select कर लिया।"},
    {"i": 23, "speaker": "bot", "text": "अब आपकी city और state बता दीजिए please।"},
    {"i": 24, "speaker": "caller", "text": "जी हाँ।"},
    {"i": 25, "speaker": "bot", "text": "ठीक है?"},
    {"i": 26, "speaker": "bot", "text": "आप अपनी city का नाम भी बता दीजिए।"},
    {"i": 27, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Bihar State तो हो गया।"},
    {"i": 28, "speaker": "caller", "text": "मेवातली जिला।"},
    {"i": 29, "speaker": "bot", "text": "आप Vaishali Bihar से बोल रहे हैं ना?"}
  ]
}
